messages:
Samir: Quick follow-up from the KV-cache OOM postmortem. We need owners, backups, clear deadlines, and explicit abort criteria for the soft-limit + reclaim rollout.
Anya: I9ll own deep profiling and RCA validation. Plan: capture low/high churn snapshots on 3 canary nodes, diff, and produce flamegraphs. ETA: Fri EOD.
Javier: I9ll own config changes and the staged rollout. Proposal: per-shard soft_limit_ratio=0.72, eviction_policy=lru_aggressive, slab_compact_interval_s=1800. Rollout: 3% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m observation. Abort if p95 latency +25ms or evictions/sec > 2x baseline.
Priya: Telemetry/helpdesk owner. I9ll add fragmentation_ratio (per-shard), kv_residency_bytes (per-model), and an alert: fragmentation delta > 12% for 10m. I9ll also add a Grafana playbook snapshot. ETA: Thu EOD.
Leon: I9ll build an emergency reclaim job (fast slab_compact) with a two-approver toggle and safety checks (abort if node CPU > 70% or IO > 60%). ETA: 48h.
Samir: Backups: Leon backs Anya for infra tasks; Priya backs Javier for rollback automation; Samir backs Priya for alerts. Add to postmortem checklist.
Anya: Short profiling commands:
```
kv_snapshot --shard=$S --out=/artifacts/kv-$S.$TS.snap
kv_diff /artifacts/kv-*.snap > /artifacts/diff.$TS.txt
flamegraph-generator /artifacts/kv-*.snap > /artifacts/flame.$TS.svg
```
Artifacts -> s3://redwood-oom/postmortem-2215000000/.
Javier: Config snippet I9ll test:
```
shard_defaults:
  soft_limit_ratio: 0.72
  eviction_policy: lru_aggressive
  slab_compact_interval_s: 1800
```
I9ll add a per-model override to disable prefix_warmer for churny models.
Priya: Runbook short steps for pager:
- Trigger: fragmentation_ratio > 12% OR evictions/sec >150 for 10m
- Action 1: disable prefix warmers for top-3 models
- Action 2: throttle heavy writers (10% steps)
- Action 3: if no improvement run Leon9s slab_compact job (2 approvers)
- Escalate to infra after 30m if still high
I9ll add exact alert thresholds and playbook links to the doc.
Leon: slab_compact job will be idempotent and per-shard; toggle requires two approvals via the UI. Will add a dry-run flag for staging.
Samir: Deadlines recap:
- Profiling artifacts & upload (Anya)
 2026-03-27 EOD
- Canary config + rollback automation (Javier)
 2026-03-25 AM
- Alerts + dashboard (Priya)
 2026-03-26 EOD
- Emergency slab_compact job & toggle (Leon)
 48h
Document PRs must reference the postmortem doc id.
Anya: Hypothesis: prefix warmers retain transient pointers preventing slab compaction; will include candidate stack traces and a patch suggestion (weaker refs / explicit release).
Javier: Short-term mitigation: set model-level prefix_warmer.max_active=0 for affected models; reversible in prod. I9ll add automation to the canary pipeline to revert on abort criteria.
Priya: I9ll create a synthetic test that churns prefixes and measures fragmentation pre/post change; run nightly in staging for a week before final rollout.
eng-oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: "KV OOM follow-up check-in" on 2026-03-30 10:00 UTC  attendees: eng-runtime.
Samir: Thanks everyone. If any owner misses a deadline, create a blocker in the postmortem doc and page me. We9ll run weekly triage for 6 weeks. :thumbsup:
